## 1 · Explainable policy
The workflow uses explicit inputs: last-session effort, sleep, fatigue and the current training week. It returns one of three actions: progress, hold or deload.

## 2 · Human control
This workflow never writes a plan. It creates a version-checked recommendation; the ActiveFlow app applies it only after a human decision.
